name: Mihrab Mat

palette.name: MIHRAB MAT / LINEN + CEDAR + WARM BRASS

summary: A prayer carpet distilled into a crowned outline, one open mihrab, and a calm horizontal row.
why: The mihrab, carpet crown and row share one centerline. A curved brass hem closes the same body instead of adding an accessory. Generous real cutouts keep the sign open and recognizable in one color.
risk: The carpet is an intimate prayer cue rather than an unmistakable mosque; at the smallest size the curved hem becomes a simple warm edge.
sub1: A single open mihrab inside a softly crowned carpet
sub2: An aligned row and integrated curved hem create a quiet rhythm
theme: Prayer carpet and aligned prayer row
reasonToChoose: A compact prayer-first identity with an expressive carpet outline and very little ornament.
